sources.title: AES Heads of State declaration on ECOWAS nationals' free movement
sources.publisher: Agence Malienne de Presse et Publicité
sources.officialityEvidence: The Malian state press agency publishes the signed declaration of the AES Heads of State, made in Bamako on 14 December 2024 by Mali's Head of State and AES President.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La Confédération des Etats du Sahel (AES) est un espace sans visa pour tout ressortissant des Etats membres de la CEDEAO.

sources.title: ECOWAS statement on continued West African free movement after AES withdrawal
sources.jurisdiction: Economic Community of West African States
sources.officialityEvidence: The current ECOWAS Commission site reports the Commission President's 31 July 2025 statement that ECOWAS and the three AES countries agreed continuing regional free movement pending a new agreement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: until a new agreement is reached, the people of West Africa will continue to benefit ... particularly ... free movement.

sources.title: ECOWAS creation history and current member states
sources.jurisdiction: Economic Community of West African States
sources.officialityEvidence: The current ECOWAS Commission page names the 12 current members and records the 29 January 2025 withdrawal of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, permitting precise mapping of the declaration's former 15-member cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: On January 29, 2025, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger officially withdrew from ECOWAS.

sources.title: Malian diplomatic missions: visa assistant
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry portal identifies itself as the official site of Mali's diplomatic and consular posts and exposes a visa query requiring nationality, passport type, residence and filing location. Reproduced ordinary-passport queries conflict with the signed AES declaration for some ECOWAS nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ai-je besoin d’un visa pour voyager au Mali ?

sources.title: Auswärtiges Amt: Mali travel and security advice
sources.officialityEvidence: Germany's Foreign Office maintains this live Mali entry page, dated 22 August 2026, for German nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Deutsche Staatsangehörige benötigen für die Einreise nach Mali ein Visum.

sources.title: France Diplomatie: Mali entry and stay
sources.publisher: Ministère de l'Europe et des Affaires étrangères
sources.officialityEvidence: France's Foreign Ministry currently publishes passport-entry guidance for French nationals travelling to Mali.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les ressortissants français sont soumis à une obligation de visa.

sources.title: Macao DSI: Mali travel-convenience record
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau, Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: The live authenticated DSI government API record for Mali returns the Macao SAR passport travel classification and stay field.

sources.title: Moldova MFA: visa regime for citizens of the Republic of Moldova
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Moldova
sources.officialityEvidence: Moldova MFA's live table, updated 20 February 2026, specifies ordinary-passport visitor treatment and obtaining method.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Mali | Viza este necesară | Misiunile Diplomatice.

sources.title: Mauritania MFA: reciprocal visa-waiver list
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Mauritanians Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: Mauritania's Foreign Ministry currently publishes its reciprocal visa-waiver agreement list and separately labels limited special-passport agreements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Liste des pays avec lesquels la Mauritanie a signé un accord de suppression réciproque de visa: Mali.

sources.title: Rwanda DGIE: visa-free countries for Rwandan passport holders
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, Rwanda
sources.officialityEvidence: Rwanda's current Immigration and Emigration Directorate table distinguishes ordinary, service and diplomatic passport treatment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: MALI | Visa not required | Visa not required | Visa not required.

sources.title: Serbia MFA: Mali travel advisory
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia MFA's live Mali advisory expressly states visa status and the available issuing channel for Serbian passport holders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: There is no possibility to apply for a visa online (eVisa) or obtain a visa at the border crossing.

policies.title: ECOWAS ordinary passports: visa-free entry to Mali under AES declaration
policies.summary: The signed AES declaration makes the AES space, including Mali, visa-free for nationals of ECOWAS member states. ECOWAS subsequently reported that the AES countries and ECOWAS agreed continued free movement pending a new agreement.
conditions: Applies only to nationals of the named ECOWAS State passport issuers holding ordinary passports for the normal visitor baseline.
ECOWAS nationals may enter, circulate, reside, establish and exit subject to national law; AES States retain the power to refuse entry to inadmissible ECOWAS nationals.

The policy does not decide employment, residence administration, commercial vehicle, diplomatic, official/service, refugee, laissez-passer, special-document, transit, crew, health, security or individual-admissibility treatment.

The live MFA assistant's residence/location-dependent ordinary-passport results conflict with this declaration for some ECOWAS nationalities (including Ghana and Cabo Verde). The signed AES declaration and later ECOWAS continuation statement are treated as controlling; the assistant is recorded as a material reconciliation risk.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: advance Mali visa
policies.summary: Germany's Foreign Office currently says German nationals need a Mali visa obtained from a Malian foreign mission in Germany.
conditions: This carried-forward ordinary-passport row requires visa application at a Malian foreign mission before travel; it does not normalize security, work, residence, special-document or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: French ordinary passports: advance Mali visa
policies.summary: France Diplomatie says French nationals require a visa issued by Mali's consulates in Paris or Lyon and cannot obtain one on arrival.
conditions: This carried-forward ordinary-passport row is an advance consular visa; it does not decide binational-document, work, residence, special-document or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: visa-free Mali visits
policies.summary: The live Macao DSI Mali record marks its passport as visa-free, not eVisa or visa on arrival, for up to 90 days.
conditions: This carried-forward row is limited to a Macao SAR passport and does not decide PRC, Hong Kong, Portuguese, special-document, purpose or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: advance Mali visa
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current table requires a Mali visa for an ordinary Moldovan passport and identifies diplomatic missions as the obtaining method.
conditions: This carried-forward ordinary-passport row is an advance diplomatic-mission route, not a conclusion from the Malian MFA assistant.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: visa-free Mali visits
policies.summary: Mauritania MFA's current reciprocal visa-waiver list names Mali without the diplomatic/service-only limitation applied elsewhere on that list.
conditions: This carried-forward row concerns a Mauritanian ordinary passport; duration, purpose, work, residence, special-document and final-admission treatment remain unestablished here.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passports: visa-free Mali visits
policies.summary: Rwanda DGIE's current passport-type table records Mali as visa-free for an ordinary Rwandan passport.
conditions: This carried-forward row is the ordinary-passport entry only and does not infer a route from regional membership or determine purpose, stay, special documents or final admission.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: advance Mali visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA directs Serbian passport holders to obtain a Mali visa at Mali's Embassy in Rome and expressly rules out online and arrival issuance.
conditions: This carried-forward ordinary-passport row requires pre-travel mission issuance; work, residence, special passports, health, security and final admission remain separate.
